Split flights to review

Flights split in two at a landing the recorded track says never happened

Each pair below was booked in as two flights, but the aircraft's recorded track shows no landing between them — a GPS speed glitch or a fast taxi the tracker counted as a flight. Undo the split folds the second leg back into the first and recalculates any unpaid invoice; Keep it leaves them as two flights and hides the pair.
